authorization_boundaries: Raw archive, Summary V1, and successful Summary V2 remain byte-immutable.
Rejected candidates are evidence only and never bypass a model call in a new revision.
Only successful hash-bound partial maps may resume within the same revision.
Each content node receives at most one formal attempt per revision.
Infra failures stop the node without consuming its content attempt or looping automatically.
Model concurrency is at most three and each explicit batch contains at most twenty nodes.
invalidation_conditions: The task manifest bytes or declared scope change.
A catalog, source workbook binding, rule status, or threshold changes.
The implementation plan adds an undeclared unit, owner, path, entrypoint, resource, or operation.

matches.compact_guidance: Resolve the declared runtime and prove the exact capability, imports, permissions, version, and working directory; never infer readiness from PATH or process existence.
forbidden_patterns: Treating command existence or process existence as sufficient proof.
Installing a global dependency before checking a registered project runtime.
invariants: The selected runtime and tool capability are proven for the exact required operation.
Audit, build, model, and product runtimes remain separately identified.

required_checks.description: Execute the exact required capability with the selected runtime and working directory.

required_patterns: Resolve an explicit runtime or tool registry when available.
Probe version, protocol, critical imports, permissions, and working directory.
matches.title: 环境存在不等于能力可用

matches.compact_guidance: Do not equate existence or exit zero with success; exercise the real entrypoint and capture before/after evidence of the promised effect.
forbidden_patterns: Reporting success solely from existence, registration, process state, or exit code.
invariants: Success is demonstrated through the user's actual entrypoint and promised state transition.

required_checks.description: Exercise the actual entrypoint and prove the expected state change.

required_patterns: Run the real user entrypoint.
Record before and after state for the promised count, waterline, file, or UI behavior.
matches.title: 文件或进程存在不等于功能生效

matches.compact_guidance: Inventory every entrypoint touching the resource and reuse one implementation or one contract suite; a new UI, updater, or worker must inherit prior regressions.
forbidden_patterns: Copying a previously fixed boundary implementation into a new entrypoint.
invariants: All entrypoints that touch the same resource share one canonical implementation or one contract test suite.

required_checks.description: List every entrypoint that reaches the affected resource.
Run the same historical regression cases through every affected entrypoint.

required_patterns: Enumerate all entrypoints and their Owner before implementation.
Route through a shared implementation or shared contract tests.
matches.title: 修复入口没有覆盖后来新增的入口

matches.compact_guidance: Use UTF-8 and structured argument or parser boundaries; test multilingual, currency, emoji, spaces, leading hyphens, and long paths.
forbidden_patterns: Concatenating untrusted or path-bearing values into a shell command string.
Using fuzzy path matches for irreversible or authoritative selection.
invariants: File and subprocess text boundaries use explicit UTF-8 where the protocol permits it.
Arguments remain structured values rather than interpolated command text.

required_checks.description: Round-trip multilingual and special-character paths and values through the production boundary.

required_patterns: Use argument arrays and structured parsers.
Test Chinese, Japanese, currency symbols, emoji, spaces, leading hyphens, and long paths.
matches.title: 默认编码与字符串命令破坏特殊字符

matches.compact_guidance: Mocks and schemas cannot prove UI, animation, installation, or background effects; run at least one real target-platform case.
forbidden_patterns: Using a mock, file count, schema pass, or process launch as the sole proof of platform behavior.
invariants: At least one validation case exercises the real installed artifact or equivalent target platform path.

required_checks.description: Exercise the production platform path and capture its visible or persisted result.

required_patterns: Validate UI visually and interactively, background work by state transition, and installers by upgrade and rollback.
matches.title: 模拟测试替代真实平台效果

matches.compact_guidance: Preserve fixtures for every released format, migrate all of them through the production path twice, and never rewrite authoritative raw data.
forbidden_patterns: Testing only the newest legacy format.
Rewriting the original authoritative archive during migration.
invariants: Every released legacy format has a minimal immutable fixture.
Migration is idempotent and never rewrites authoritative raw data.

required_checks.description: Migrate all released format fixtures through the production migration path.
Run migration twice and prove the second run is a no-op.

required_patterns: Migrate every released fixture to the current format.
Run each migration twice and require no second-run additions, count drift, or byte changes.
matches.title: 持久格式迁移只覆盖最近一种旧格式

matches.compact_guidance: Periodic work needs a cursor, waterline, cap, lease, and recovery point; prove a normal cycle scales with new data rather than total history.
forbidden_patterns: Recursively scanning the full tree, log set, or archive on every refresh or schedule tick.
invariants: Normal-cycle work is bounded by new data, an explicit batch cap, and a recoverable waterline.

required_checks.description: Use production-scale fixtures to prove per-cycle work is bounded by the delta and configured cap.

required_patterns: Persist cursor, waterline, batch limit, lease, and recovery point.
Report rows, bytes, and elapsed time processed in the current cycle.
matches.title: 定时任务把总历史工作伪装成增量工作

matches.compact_guidance: Optimization must be explicit, type-allowlisted, local, and evidence-preserving; never globally proxy tools or discard code, diffs, conversations, or raw archives.
forbidden_patterns: Globally proxying commands, MCP, code, diffs, searches, conversations, or archives.
Using an undisclosed external model or network path.
invariants: Raw evidence remains available and the projection can locate its source.
Optimization is explicit and restricted to an approved content-type allowlist.

required_checks.description: Prove every compact item can locate retained raw evidence and unsupported types remain unmodified.

required_patterns: Retain raw files and fail back to raw evidence.
Activate only for explicitly allowed repetitive structured data.
matches.title: 优化或压缩破坏证据和作用域

matches.compact_guidance: Bind code, docs, manifest, package, installed artifact, tag, tests, and release evidence to one exact candidate SHA.
forbidden_patterns: Publishing a package built from a different SHA than the tested candidate.
Claiming a documented feature exists without verifying the packaged artifact contains it.
invariants: One exact candidate SHA binds source, documentation, manifest, binary version, tests, and release evidence.

required_checks.description: Bind source, docs, manifest, package, installed artifact, tag, and CI evidence to one SHA.

required_patterns: Verify scenario IDs and documentation tokens before release.
After merge, wait for CI on the exact main-branch SHA before building release artifacts.
matches.title: 文档、版本、二进制和发布证据漂移

matches.compact_guidance: Keep incident facts at project scope; promote only portable mechanisms stripped of paths, versions, permissions, and project-specific defaults.
forbidden_patterns: Writing one project's paths, permissions, models, or platform choices as a global default.
invariants: Facts remain at the lowest common ancestor that owns every intended target.
Only path-, version-, permission-, and project-independent mechanisms may be promoted.

required_checks.description: Verify promoted wording contains no project-specific path, permission, version, or implementation default.

required_patterns: Separate incident fact from portable mechanism.
Require project Owners to retain authority over concrete implementation and stricter gates.
matches.title: 项目事实被过度提升成全局规则

matches.compact_guidance: Persistent rules need target-based machine discovery, preflight hashes, completion receipts, and fail-closed drift handling; passive Markdown is not enforcement.
forbidden_patterns: Treating documentation existence as proof that future tasks will read or follow it.
invariants: Applicable governance is discovered by target path through a machine registry.
Start and completion evidence are hash-bound and fail closed on drift.

required_checks.description: Prove target-based discovery and hash-bound preflight work without chat memory.
Reject missing receipts, registry drift, unknown families, and unchanged required project workbooks.

required_patterns: Register applicable documents and rules by target scope.
Freeze input hashes at preflight and verify applicable families and required updates at completion.
matches.title: 被动文档没有执行力
